p on p.param_code = 'CRIMP_LENGTH' and p.del_flag = '0' where r.schedule_date = @schedule_date and r.del_flag = '0' and r.steel_strip_code2 is not null

select concat(r.bead_code, '-', ifnull(m.machine_name, 'null')) as code , r.mid_plan_qty as dayPlanQty, r.night_plan_qty, r.day_plan_qty as nextDayPlanQty, 0 curlLength, 0 dayPlanQtyRollNum, 0 nightPlanQtyRollNum, 0 nextDayPlanQtyRollNum from t_tq_schedule_result r left join t_tq_machine_info m on r.machine_id = m.id where r.schedule_date = @schedule_date and r.del_flag = '0'
